source: Interim team, hand-written. Item structure (attributes, 5-point response scales, 7-day recall window) is modeled on the NCI PRO-CTCAE item library (https://healthcaredelivery.cancer.gov/pro-ctcae/). Question wording is Interim's own plain language and is NOT the NCI item text; a production deployment licenses the official PRO-CTCAE items from NCI.
rationale: Ten symptom items chosen for immune-related adverse-event relevance on PD-1 inhibitors such as cemiplimab (pneumonitis, colitis, dermatitis, arthritis, mucositis, fatigue, fever). Each item carries the PRO-CTCAE attribute pattern for that symptom (e.g. shortness of breath = severity + interference; nausea = frequency + severity; diarrhea = frequency only; rash = presence). Response labels map to the 0..4 integers the composite scoring table expects. The participant never sees grades or clinical terms; `label` is the symptom in plain words and `prompts` are the one-question-per-screen stems the kiosk shows.

prompts.severity: In the last 7 days, how bad was your shortness of breath when it was at its worst?
prompts.interference: In the last 7 days, how much did shortness of breath get in the way of your usual daily activities?

prompts.severity: In the last 7 days, how bad was your cough when it was at its worst?
prompts.interference: In the last 7 days, how much did coughing get in the way of your usual daily activities?

items.label: Fatigue, tiredness or lack of energy

prompts.severity: In the last 7 days, how bad was your tiredness or lack of energy when it was at its worst?
prompts.interference: In the last 7 days, how much did tiredness get in the way of your usual daily activities?

prompts.frequency: In the last 7 days, how often did you feel nauseous or sick to your stomach?
prompts.severity: In the last 7 days, how bad was the nausea when it was at its worst?

prompts.frequency: In the last 7 days, how often did you have loose or watery stools?

prompts.presence: In the last 7 days, did you have a rash anywhere on your skin?

prompts.severity: In the last 7 days, how bad was any itching of your skin when it was at its worst?
In the last 7 days, how bad was any pain or stiffness in your joints when it was at its worst?
prompts.interference: In the last 7 days, how much did joint pain get in the way of your usual daily activities?

prompts.presence: In the last 7 days, did you have a fever or chills?

optional_fields.label: If you took your temperature, what was the highest reading? (optional)
optional_fields.note: Participant-typed, not device-measured. Evidence only; it never changes the provisional grade.

prompts.severity: In the last 7 days, how bad were any sores in your mouth or throat when they were at their worst?
prompts.interference: In the last 7 days, how much did mouth or throat sores get in the way of eating, drinking or talking?
